name: SteelSeries keyboard lighting
author: dreamsgarage
description: Per-key RGB for the MSI SteelSeries KLC laptop keyboard: base colour, named groups and single keys as editable layers, presets, lights off and restore. Model detected from DMI.

barWidget.description: Colour the SteelSeries KLC deck by board, group or key. Left = panel, right = lights off, middle = restore.
